name: NetAlertX
description: Network visibility and asset intelligence that discovers devices via ARP and passive protocols. Deploys the official Docker image in a privileged LXC with host networking.

notes.text: Defaults to a privileged LXC with nesting and keyctl so Docker can use host networking and ARP/raw sockets. Unprivileged mode limits discovery (`var_unprivileged=1`).
Host networking is mandatory. Put the LXC on the same LAN/VLAN as the networks you monitor.
Web UI: http://<container-ip>:20211 (GraphQL API 20212). Initial discovery can take 5–10 minutes.
SCAN_SUBNETS at install takes a CIDR and interface, e.g. `var_scan_subnets="['192.168.1.0/24 --interface=eth0']"`; otherwise set it in Settings.
Data: /opt/netalertx/data (config/, db/); image ghcr.io/netalertx/netalertx:latest. Upstream arp_ignore/arp_announce sysctls are omitted; set them on the Proxmox host.
Update: `update` inside the LXC or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`; PHS_SILENT=1 for unattended.
